task.title: Transport: Rust RequestV2 tree variant and Desktop platform capability exposure, with tests
task.description: Carry the new v2 `tree` action (already implemented in Core by T5: see src/integrations/metaproject-explorer-contract.ts, MetaprojectTreeV2 / MetaprojectTreeEntry / parseV2 'tree' case) through the Desktop transport, as plan.md section 'Transport' says. (1) apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/metaproject.rs: add RequestV2::Tree { scope (graph|wiki), parent: Option<String>, cursor: Option<String>, expected_snapshot_id } validated in valid_v2 (graph parent = relative_path, wiki parent = valid_text, cursor = valid_text, pin = digest); keep ACTIONS (the set a CLI must offer) at the six existing actions; add Rust unit tests next to the existing ones for accept/refuse of tree requests and for the unchanged required set. There is NO cargo on this machine: you cannot compile Rust; write it carefully in the file's existing style, mirror existing variants exactly, and say clearly in your result that Rust was not compiled (CI will). (2) apps/desktop/src/platform/metaproject.ts: KNOWN DEFECT from T5 — around line 172 the capability check requires every action in METAPROJECT_CAPABILITIES, which now includes `tree`, so an older CLI without `tree` would be refused. Change it to a fixed required set (the six actions Desktop always sends) and expose whether the answering CLI offers `tree` (e.g. a `supportsTree`/capability set from the negotiation that the view can read). Add the request/response typing and a response guard for `tree` responses, and a function the view can call to request a tree page (follow how openspec-list is requested and guarded). Update apps/desktop/src/platform/metaproject.test.ts: its fixtures build capabilities from METAPROJECT_CAPABILITIES (~lines 65-67) — add cases: CLI offering the six actions only negotiates fine and reports tree unsupported; CLI offering tree reports it supported; a malformed tree response is rejected. (3) apps/desktop/dev/bridge.ts uses parseExplorerRequest and should need no change; confirm and say so. Do NOT build the tree UI (that is T7) and do not change MetaprojectView beyond what the type changes force; if a type change forces a view edit, keep it minimal and report it.

acceptance_criteria: AC3: The Desktop Rust command accepts a well-formed `tree` request, refuses a malformed one, and still requires of a CLI only the six existing actions. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo test --locked metaproject`]

AC4: Desktop learns from the capability probe whether the CLI offers `tree`; against a CLI that does not, the explorer negotiates successfully and the sidebar shows today's flat list with no error. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/platform/metaproject.test.ts src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx` · sensitive: failure-scenario]
